threat_event: Attacker uses a vendor or engineer remote session through the OT remote access gateway to reach a Port plant EWS and change Ammonia Unit setpoints, alarm limits, or interlock bypasses, leading to a toxic ammonia release
threat_source: Nation-state or advanced group targeting chemical facilities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateway uses push MFA, not phishing-resistant; session approvals by phone and not logged (6 of 20 sampled); privileged commands not blocked outside MOC; recordings not reviewed; OT alerts watched in business hours only
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R02 (33 CFR 101.650(a)(4); 33 CFR 101.650(f)(3); 33 CFR 101.650(h)(2)); 40 CFR 68.67(c)(4); C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark)
existing_controls: OT DMZ and firewall pair; gateway with named accounts, MFA, approval, recording; allowlisting on DCS stations; independent SIS; MOC for control changes
treatment_plan: FIDO2 keys for all gateway users who can change configuration; approvals logged in the gateway; technical block on logic downloads outside approved MOC windows; monthly third-party session review; MSSP OT monitoring 24x7; add cyber-initiated scenarios to the Ammonia Unit HAZOP
exposure_estimate_usd: $5M-$25M (release response, injuries, community claims, RMP and USCG enforcement, 7+ days Port outage)

threat_event: Ransomware spreads from the business network across the IT/OT conduits into the Port plant supervisory zone (historian, historian clients, terminal HMIs, DCS servers), forcing all Port units to a safe state for about 7 days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Conduit logs collected but not reviewed; OT sensor alerts by email in business hours; allowlisting and antivirus missing on historian clients and terminal HMIs; full DCS restore never tested
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-06; BP-02 to BP-08
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R02 (33 CFR 101.650(h)(2); 33 CFR 101.650(g)(4)); C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark)
existing_controls: Firewall pair and OT DMZ (2023); EDR and MSSP on IT; allowlisting on 10 DCS stations; weekly offline configuration copies
treatment_plan: MSSP OT monitoring service with 24x7 review of sensor alerts and conduit logs; allowlisting on historian clients, terminal HMIs, and the SIS EWS; restrict historian client access to the replica; full DCS restore test; joint cyber and process tabletop
exposure_estimate_usd: $3M-$8M (about $2.5M unrecovered Port revenue over 7 days, $400K third-party supply, forensics and rebuild)

threat_event: Ransomware with data theft encrypts corporate endpoints, file services, LIMS, and TTRS and blocks SSO, cutting shipping to about 60% for 72 hours and exposing formulations and employee data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA open to adversary-in-the-middle phishing; over-shared file services with no data loss prevention; TTRS and file services not restore-tested; no break-glass ERP access
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-09 to SYS-15; SYS-18; BP-09; BP-13 to BP-17
existing_controls: EDR and 24x7 MSSP; immutable backups in a separate account; MFA for all users; privileged access vault
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; restrict SSI and formulation shares; restore tests for file services and TTRS; break-glass ERP accounts; ransomware runbook exercise (P08 runbook 2)
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$4M (about $770K unrecovered revenue and overtime, breach response, notification; insurance limit $15M, retention $500K)

threat_event: Attacker reaches the Inland plant SCADA server from the office VLAN or through the integrator's always-on remote desktop tool and alters PLC logic or recipes, causing an incompatible mixture or a long outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inland network separated only by a VLAN access list; always-on remote desktop without MFA; shared and default-style PLC and HMI passwords; no OT monitoring; no allowlisting on HMIs
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); internal standard (Inland plant is outside the FSP)
existing_controls: Office EDR; VLAN access list
treatment_plan: Remove the always-on tool and route the integrator through a gateway with MFA and approval; firewall between the office and SCADA networks; change all default and shared PLC and HMI passwords; extend the OT sensor to Inland
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$3M (Inland output about $360K a day, weeks to rebuild PLC programs, possible injury)

threat_event: An operator or contractor uses a shared console account to change setpoints or recipes without attribution, by mistake or on purpose
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operators share one account per console position at both plants; console changes cannot be tied to a person
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-08; BP-03 to BP-05; BP-12
existing_controls: Staffed, badge-controlled control room; DCS role levels; MOC for engineering changes
treatment_plan: Unique operator accounts with badge-tap login at the Port plant; unique HMI accounts at the Inland plant

threat_event: After ransomware, a destructive attack, or a server failure, the Port DCS and batch system cannot be rebuilt within the 12-hour RTO for the Ammonia Unit and Blend Hall 1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only one operator station has ever been restored; no tested rebuild of the DCS server pair from clean media
existing_controls: Nightly online and weekly offline configuration copies; spare controller and server hardware on site
treatment_plan: Full restore test on spare hardware (2026-11-10), then yearly; OT contingency plan; rebuild procedure from clean media with the DCS integrator
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$3M (each extra day of Port downtime costs about $350K unrecovered)

threat_event: The only copies of the 14 Inland PLC programs are lost when the controls engineer's laptop is lost, fails, or is encrypted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PLC programs stored only on one engineer's laptop; integrator holds 2023 project files only
existing_controls: Integrator project files from 2023
treatment_plan: Copy current programs to the OT backup server and the offline safe; quarterly compare against running PLCs

threat_event: SIS logic is altered or drifts from the approved version and the change is not found until the next yearly proof test, so a safety function fails on demand
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SIS logic compared with the approved copy only at the annual proof test; no SIS logging to the SIEM
existing_controls: SIS keyswitch; separate SIS network and EWS; MOC for SIS changes; yearly proof test
treatment_plan: Monthly automated logic compare with the approved copy; keyswitch position alarm in the control room; SIS EWS logs to the SIEM
exposure_estimate_usd: $5M-$25M (as R-001 if a safety function fails during a release)

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known (KEV-listed) vulnerability in an OT workstation, DCS server, or end-of-support operating system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT patched only at the annual turnaround; no KEV tracking for OT; DCS one major release behind; 9 end-of-support workstations
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R02 (33 CFR 101.625(d)(15); 33 CFR 101.650(e)(3)(i)); C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark)
existing_controls: Allowlisting on DCS stations; firewall zones
treatment_plan: Monthly KEV match against the OT asset register; documented compensating controls for KEVs that cannot be patched; DCS upgrade at the 2027 turnaround

threat_event: Attacker performs reconnaissance and stages tools in the OT networks for weeks without detection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT sensor alerts seen only in business hours; conduit logs not reviewed; no Inland monitoring
existing_controls: Passive OT sensor at the Port plant; firewall logs in the SIEM
treatment_plan: MSSP OT monitoring service; weekly review of conduit log summary until then; Inland sensor

threat_event: Attacker or insider on the supervisory network logs in to the radar tank gauging server with the vendor default administrator password and falsifies tank levels, leading to a bulk acid or caustic tank overfill during a barge transfer
threat_source: Adversary on the OT network or insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default administrator password on the tank gauging server; web interface reachable from the whole supervisory zone (found in P07, 2026-08-19)
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R02 (33 CFR 101.650(a)(2); 33 CFR 101.650(h)(1)); C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark)
existing_controls: SIS high-level trips on the bulk tanks; password changed 2026-08-20
treatment_plan: Restrict the web interface to the terminal HMIs; sweep all Port OT devices for default passwords; add the server to the asset baseline and log forwarding

threat_event: The Port plant misses the 2027-07-16 deadline for the Cybersecurity Assessment and Cybersecurity Plan, or the plan is not approved, and the Captain of the Port imposes conditions on operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan draft about 30% complete; assessment not started; training deadline already missed by 59 employees and all contractors
existing_controls: CySO designated in writing; FSP and FSO in place; this SSP (P02) covers most plan sections
treatment_plan: Program roadmap in P03 with quarterly milestones; Cybersecurity Assessment 2027-01 to 2027-03; plan submission by 2027-06-15
exposure_estimate_usd: $250K-$2M (civil penalties, operating restrictions at the terminal)

threat_event: A cyber incident at the Port plant is reported late or to the wrong agencies (33 CFR 6.16-1 or 101.305)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cyber reporting under 6.16-1 not in the FSP procedures; staff unaware that CISA and the FBI must be called
existing_controls: FSP reporting procedures for breaches of security and TSIs
treatment_plan: Notification matrix (P08); FSP amendment; reporting card in the control room

threat_event: During a toxic release the control room cannot warn the community or call agencies because VoIP phones and the notification web console depend on the business network that is down
threat_source: Ransomware or network outage during an emergency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Control room VoIP on the business network; community notification launched from a web console; printed call list out of date
existing_controls: Radios and cellular phones exist; satellite phone in the control room
treatment_plan: Dedicated cellular phones and a printed, monthly-checked call list in the control room, gatehouse, and response vehicle; second launch path for community notification; test in the 2026-11-17 exercise

threat_event: A compromised DCS integrator, SIS vendor, or tank gauging vendor pushes malicious code or uses its gateway access as an entry point
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vendor security reviews after onboarding; no notice clauses; integrator accounts had broad zone rights (fixed 2026-09-15)
existing_controls: Gateway with approval and recording; hash checks on DCS updates
treatment_plan: Annual OT vendor reviews; notice clauses; per-zone gateway rights

threat_event: Malware enters a DCS station on a USB drive or vendor laptop during the turnaround
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB ports open on 14 local HMIs; vendor tools not inventoried
existing_controls: Media kiosk; allowlisting on DCS stations
treatment_plan: Disable USB storage on all HMIs; vendor tool register

threat_event: A former employee or contractor uses an OT account or loading bay driver card that was not removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT accounts and driver cards outside the identity provider; removed by hand; P07 found 3 DCS accounts and 2 driver cards of leavers
existing_controls: Termination checklist; TWIC revocation at the gate
treatment_plan: Termination checklist linked to OT and card systems; quarterly OT access reviews

threat_event: Loading bay automation is manipulated to load 50% hydrogen peroxide into an unauthorized vehicle or to overfill a cargo tank
threat_source: Criminal seeking explosive precursors, or insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Driver card list outside the identity provider; bay controllers lack a configuration baseline
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(6) theft and diversion; 27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); 49 CFR 172.802(a)(2)
existing_controls: Driver cards and TWIC at the gate; ERP bill of lading match
treatment_plan: Driver card list reconciled weekly with carrier approvals; bay controller baseline

threat_event: Hydrogen peroxide is diverted through a fraudulent order or altered ERP customer master data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Second approval only for peroxide customer changes since 2025; no review of new ship-to addresses
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(5) shipping, receipt, and storage; 27.230(a)(6) theft and diversion, voluntary benchmark)
existing_controls: Customer vetting; two approvals for peroxide master data
treatment_plan: Monthly review of new peroxide ship-to addresses

threat_event: An identity provider outage or lockout blocks access to the ERP and other SaaS applications for more than a shift
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No break-glass ERP accounts outside SSO
existing_controls: Identity vendor SOC 2; vendor status monitoring
treatment_plan: Two break-glass ERP accounts per site held by the CFO and the IT Director, tested quarterly

threat_event: A TTRS outage longer than 24 hours leaves water utilities without replenishment orders
threat_source: Cloud region outage or failed deployment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single cloud region; no tested failover; 99.5% availability not measured; phone workaround never drilled
existing_controls: Database point-in-time recovery; daily snapshots to the backup account
treatment_plan: Second-region standby for the database and ingestion; availability measurement; quarterly drill of the phone workaround

threat_event: Attacker compromises TTRS cellular gateways through shared credentials or outdated firmware and sends false tank levels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 37% of gateways on outdated firmware; one shared local credential per gateway model
existing_controls: Device certificates for cloud connection; plausibility checks in the replenishment engine
treatment_plan: Firmware campaign; unique local credentials per gateway; plausibility alerts

threat_event: A change to the replenishment engine creates wrong or duplicate orders that reach the ERP and the fleet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No formal change management for replenishment rules and code
existing_controls: Order validation rules (capacity, minimum load)
treatment_plan: Change process with peer review, test evidence, and release approval

threat_event: The TTRS SOC 2 Type 2 report is not ready in 2027, and two water utilities and the pulp and paper group move business elsewhere
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Readiness gaps in change management, availability, vendor oversight (P09)
existing_controls: Readiness assessment done 2026-09-04
treatment_plan: Remediate P09 gaps by 2027-03-31; Type 1 report as of 2027-03-31; Type 2 observation period 2027-04-01 to 2027-09-30

threat_event: SSI (the FSP and Facility Security Assessment), legacy CVI, or formulations are copied from shares open to 65 users
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Over-shared file services; no data loss prevention; AI-002 surfaces over-shared files
regulatory_driver: 49 CFR 1520.9; C-CHEMICAL-R02 (33 CFR 101.630(b)); C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.400 CVI, legacy, voluntary benchmark)
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; access logging since 2026-08
treatment_plan: Restricted shares for 14 named users; SSI labels; data loss prevention in 2027
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$3M (trade secrets; SSI disclosure is a regulatory violation)

threat_event: A departing chemist or engineer takes formulations or master recipes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No data loss prevention; exports from the batch system not monitored
existing_controls: Confidentiality agreements; recipe access by role
treatment_plan: Export alerts on recipe and formulation stores; exit interview checklist

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts a customer or supplier payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes verified by email only at some sites
existing_controls: Mail filtering; awareness training
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for all bank changes; finance training

threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing bypasses push MFA and takes over an IT or cloud administrator account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA for administrators; no phishing-resistant authenticators
existing_controls: Number matching; privileged access vault; conditional access
treatment_plan: FIDO2 keys for all administrators and gateway users

threat_event: A cloud storage bucket or database is exposed to the internet by misconfiguration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails strong but no written configuration standard
existing_controls: Organization guardrails; posture service
treatment_plan: Configuration standard STD-02

threat_event: An attacker with cloud administrator rights deletes or encrypts the backup vault
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: None material: separate account, write-once lock, separate credentials
existing_controls: Write-once retention; non-federated credentials
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO 2026-09-22: controls exceed the appetite; reviewed yearly

threat_event: Employee personal information (SSNs, background checks, payroll) is exposed through the HR SaaS or a phishing attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR vendor SOC 2 not reviewed
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171; each state where affected employees reside
existing_controls: HR administrators limited; MFA
treatment_plan: Review the HR vendor SOC 2; breach runbook steps for employee data (P08)

threat_event: A breach at one of the 8 key SaaS vendors whose SOC 2 reports have not been reviewed exposes company data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SOC 2 reviewed for 3 of 11 key SaaS vendors; no complementary control mapping
existing_controls: Contracts with security terms for SaaS
treatment_plan: Vendor SOC 2 review program (P09)

threat_event: An OT vendor knows of a vulnerability or a breach in its own systems but does not tell the company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT contracts lack notice clauses (gap 7)
existing_controls: Vendor advisories subscribed
treatment_plan: Notice clauses by amendment

threat_event: A hurricane causes days of power and communications loss, and the plant restarts OT without checking configuration integrity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No post-event integrity check in the restart procedure
existing_controls: Hurricane plan; generator for the control room; UPS
treatment_plan: Integrity check step (configuration compare) in the restart procedure

threat_event: Cameras, badge readers, or TWIC readers are disabled through the video management server on the business network to support theft or intrusion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Video management server on the business network
existing_controls: Guard force; FSP measures
treatment_plan: Move the video management server and badge controllers to a security systems VLAN behind the firewall

threat_event: Fleet telematics or route data for 50% peroxide shipments is accessed to plan theft en route
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DOT security plan does not address cyber risks to telematics
existing_controls: Role-limited access in the fleet system
treatment_plan: Cyber measures in the DOT plan revision

threat_event: The DOT hazmat security plan stays out of date (last revised 2021, 2025 review missed) and fails a PHMSA inspection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual review missed; plan does not address cyber risks to shipping papers, driver cards, telematics
existing_controls: Plan from 2019; hazmat training program
treatment_plan: Annual review and revision with cyber measures; security training refresh

threat_event: Operators accept an AI-001 setpoint recommendation that is outside safe limits or based on stale data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-001 deployed without a risk assessment; recommendations not checked against the safe operating limits
existing_controls: Operators enter changes by hand; SIS independent; no write path to the DCS
treatment_plan: Hard check against the safe operating limit table; MOC for model changes; operator guidance (P10)

threat_event: AI-004 under-forecasts demand and a water utility runs short of treatment chemical, or over-forecasts and a delivery overfills a customer tank
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Forecast monitoring only weekly; no human review for new tanks
existing_controls: Capacity check on orders
treatment_plan: Daily forecast error alerts; human review for the first 60 days of each new tank (P10)

threat_event: Staff paste formulations, SSI, or process data into public generative AI tools, or AI-002 surfaces over-shared SSI to users without a need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved AI tools list until 2026-09; over-shared files
existing_controls: Acceptable use policy
treatment_plan: Approved AI tools list; web filter for public AI tools; fix gap 10 shares (P10)

threat_event: AI-005 drafts an SDS with wrong hazard information that is released without expert review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Draft review checklist not yet written
existing_controls: Regulatory specialist reviews every SDS
treatment_plan: SDS review checklist and sign-off (P10)

threat_event: AI-003 misses a developing pump or agitator failure, or its false alarms lead planners to defer maintenance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model performance not yet measured
existing_controls: Mechanical integrity program runs independently of AI-003
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO 2026-09-22: AI-003 is advisory and does not replace inspections; measure performance quarterly

threat_event: Historian replica or data platform records are tampered with, skewing AI-001 and AI-003
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrity check added 2026-09 only
existing_controls: One-way replication; role-limited write access
treatment_plan: Daily row-count and checksum comparison (done); quarterly review

threat_event: Configuration drift weakens OT and server settings because standards for OT security, configuration, and logging are missing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No supporting standards (gap 14)
existing_controls: Vendor-hardened DCS image
treatment_plan: Standards STD-01 to STD-06 (P06)

threat_event: Operators treat cyber-caused anomalies as instrument faults and keep running
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No joint cyber and process exercise; OT training gaps
existing_controls: Alarm management program
treatment_plan: Joint tabletop 2026-11-17; cyber cues in operator training

threat_event: The Inland controls engineer leaves, and nobody can change or restore the Inland PLCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single point of knowledge
existing_controls: Integrator support contract
treatment_plan: Cross-train a Port controls engineer; document PLC architecture

threat_event: A rogue wireless device or unauthorized laptop is connected to the Port control network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unused switch ports enabled in the field
existing_controls: No wireless in OT zones; OT sensor alerts on new devices
treatment_plan: Disable unused switch ports

threat_event: After an incident, investigators cannot reconstruct OT activity because DCS logs roll over after 90 days and are not centralized
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DCS audit trails local only; 90-day rollover
existing_controls: SIEM retains firewall and gateway logs 12 months
treatment_plan: Forward DCS security logs to the SIEM

threat_event: Breach notification for employee data is late (Florida 30 days)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Breach steps for employee data not in the IR plan until P08
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(3)-(4); each state where affected employees reside
existing_controls: General Counsel and outside counsel on call
treatment_plan: Notification matrix and runbook 2 steps (P08)

threat_event: Denial of service against the TTRS portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal internet-facing
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; web application firewall; replenishment continues without the portal
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO 2026-09-22: replenishment and telemetry do not depend on the portal

threat_event: Loss of internet links at a plant isolates it from the cloud LIMS and the SaaS ERP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet provider at the Inland plant
existing_controls: Two providers at the Port plant; paper workarounds
treatment_plan: Second internet provider at the Inland plant

threat_event: An IT/OT firewall change error opens an unintended path or blocks DCS communications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firewall changes outside MOC; no safety review
existing_controls: Change approval by the Controls Engineering Manager
treatment_plan: Firewall changes added to MOC scope
